questions.questionText:
Arjun
 is older than Sumit but younger than Rahul. Vikas is younger than
 Rahul but older than Arjun. Ramesh is the oldest among them. Who
 is the third oldest?
questions.questionHtml: Arjun is older than Sumit but younger than Rahul. Vikas is younger than Rahul but older than Arjun. Ramesh is the oldest among them. Who is the third oldest?

options.rawHtml: Sumit
Arjun
Rahul
Vikas

questions.solutionText:
From
 the given conditions: 

 Arjun
 > Sumit, but Arjun < Rahul. 

 → Rahul
 > Arjun > Sumit. 

 Vikas
 is younger than Rahul but older than Arjun. 

 → Rahul
 > Vikas > Arjun > Sumit. 

 Ramesh
 is the oldest. 

 Final
 order: Ramesh > Rahul > Vikas > Arjun > Sumit. 

 The
 third oldest is Vikas.
questions.solutionHtml:
From the given conditions:

Arjun > Sumit, but Arjun < Rahul.

→ Rahul > Arjun > Sumit.

Vikas is younger than Rahul but older than Arjun.

→ Rahul > Vikas > Arjun > Sumit.

Ramesh is the oldest.

Final order: Ramesh > Rahul > Vikas > Arjun > Sumit.

The third oldest is Vikas.

options.rawHtml: P
Q
R
S

questions.solutionText:
From
 the given conditions: 

 P
 > S, but P < Q → Q > P > S. 

 R
 > Q, but R < U → U > R > Q. 

 T
 is the tallest. 

 Final
 order: T > U > R > Q > P > S. 

 The
 fourth tallest person is Q.
questions.solutionHtml:
From the given conditions:

P > S, but P < Q → Q > P > S.

R > Q, but R < U → U > R > Q.

T is the tallest.

Final order: T > U > R > Q > P > S.

The fourth tallest person is Q.

Mohan

 is lighter than Rahul but heavier than Suresh. → Mohan >
 Rahul > Kunal > Suresh 

 Deepak

 Solution: 

 The

questions.questionText:
In
 a north-facing row of 45 students, Neha is 13th from the left, and
 Priya is 15th from the right. There are 4 students between Priya
 and Rani, who is equidistant to Neha. What is Rani’s
 position from the right?
questions.questionHtml: In a north-facing row of 45 students, Neha is 13th from the left, and Priya is 15th from the right. There are 4 students between Priya and Rani, who is equidistant to Neha. What is Rani’s position from the right?

options.rawHtml: 25
20
30
32

questions.solutionText:
Priya’s position from the left = 45−15+1=31. 

 Rani’s position from the left (5 places ahead of Priya) = 31−5=26. 

 Check equidistance: ∣26−13∣=13 (same as Neha's position).  

 Rani’s position from the right = 45−26+1=20.
questions.solutionHtml:
Priya’s position from the left = 45−15+1=31.

Rani’s position from the left (5 places ahead of Priya) = 31−5=26.

Check equidistance: ∣26−13∣=13 (same as Neha's position). 

Rani’s position from the right = 45−26+1=20.

questions.questionText:
If
 the rank of Rohan is 7th from the top in a group of 50 candidates
 and 2 new candidates are added just before and after him, what
 will be his new rank from bottom?
questions.questionHtml: If the rank of Rohan is 7th from the top in a group of 50 candidates and 2 new candidates are added just before and after him, what will be his new rank from bottom?

options.rawHtml: 44
45
46
48

questions.solutionText:
Adding
 of candidates just before Rohan will not change his rank from
 bottom. Before addition, the rank of Rohan from bottom is = (50 -
 7) + 1 = 44 

 Now
 adding 2 candidates just after Rohan will increase his rank by 2
 positions. Hence; the new rank of Rohan from bottom will be = 44 +
 2 = 46
questions.solutionHtml:
Adding of candidates just before Rohan will not change his rank from bottom. Before addition, the rank of Rohan from bottom is = (50 - 7) + 1 = 44

Now adding 2 candidates just after Rohan will increase his rank by 2 positions. Hence; the new rank of Rohan from bottom will be = 44 + 2 = 46

questions.questionText:

 a class of 35 students, Ziya is placed 7th from the bottom where
 as Sofia is placed 9th from the top. Shahruk is placed in between
 the two. What is Ziya's position from Shahruk?
questions.questionHtml: In a class of 35 students, Ziya is placed 7th from the bottom where as Sofia is placed 9th from the top. Shahruk is placed in between the two. What is Ziya's position from Shahruk?

options.rawHtml: 10
15
19
21

questions.solutionText:
As
 seen in the figure, Shahruk is between Sofia and Ziya. It's given
 that Ziya is 7th from the bottom and Sofia is 9th from the top. 

 Therefore,
 number of persons between Sofia and Ziya = 35-(9+7) = 19 

 Sharuk's
 position between Sofia and Ziya = 19-1/2 = 10. 

 Hence,
 Shahruk is at the middle ie. at 10th position from both. Ziya,
 therefore, is at the 10th position from Shahruk

Therefore, number of persons between Sofia and Ziya = 35-(9+7) = 19

Sharuk's position between Sofia and Ziya = 19-1/2 = 10.

Hence, Shahruk is at the middle ie. at 10th position from both. Ziya, therefore, is at the 10th position from Shahruk
